يستلمون (form VIII)
# يَسْتَلِمُونَ (yastalimūna) /jas.ta.li.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# يُسْتَلَمُونَ (yustalamūna) /jus.ta.la.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
